name: adopt-ai-use-stories
description: Prepares a consent note, an interview guide and three to five short anonymous accounts of real AI use at work, each drafted from the teller's own words, approved by the teller and marked as one case. Use for "run adopt-ai-use-stories", "AI use stories", "collect stories of AI use", "real examples of AI at work", "AI case stories from our teams", "interview guide for AI use", "consent note for a use story", "examples that are not demos", part of the Claude Guide for AI Adoption Pack by 90n.
